recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. No FHIR core follow-up is needed; future PersonalRelationship.period maintenance belongs in HL7/admin-incubator.
issue_request: FHIR-50376 was an Applied FHIR-core R6 ballot issue, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to clarify the apparent contradiction between PersonalRelationship.period's definition that absent dates mean an unknown interval and its comment that permanent relationships should omit .period. The approved clarification was to say that permanent relationships omit the period end date.
initial_application: The Jira application comment identifies core commit a0df14f47ec1225319b7120d4da206fc16a4ca1c. That commit changed source/personalrelationship/structuredefinition-PersonalRelationship.xml from "the .period should be omitted" to "the period end date should be omitted" while PersonalRelationship was still a core draft resource.
additional_context: Later core commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed PersonalRelationship from core source and converted current core references to the Admin Incubator URL. Current source/fhir.ini has no PersonalRelationship entry and no source/personalrelationship files are tracked. The current HL7/admin-incubator source at input/resources/personalrelationship/StructureDefinition-PersonalRelationship.xml still has the corrected PersonalRelationship.period comment. PA/PC May 2025 minutes also record discussion of FHIR-50376 and a 13-0-0 motion.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source was changed. The issue is now external to the current core checkout/build scope, and the external owning repository already preserves the approved clarification, so an empty external-repo audit commit was published.
